status: exploratory (run card docs/research-log.md 'Run card C12-3', commit 190045db; model choice 080af302 before the held-out run)
choice: choose_model on development phase 1: independent accuracy at readout 48 was 0.227 (qwen0.5b) and 0.547 (qwen1.5b); qwen1.5b is closer to 0.5 (docs/pi/c12-3-choices.json)
label: At the primary coupling c = 0.25, live exchange does not resolve any excess same-wrong agreement over independent agents (+1.6 points, 95 % interval -0.6 to +3.9; 64 held-out problems x 8 pairs) or over replayed messages (+0.8, -1.8 to +3.3). It lowers accuracy at 48 steps (-5.5 points, -9.1 to -1.9), as replayed and unrelated messages also do. At c = 0.5 the agents lock (equal top-1 tokens in 94 % of steps 16-48), and same-wrong agreement rises from 3.7 % to 41.0 % (+37.3 points, 31.6 to 43.2) while accuracy falls by 12.5 points (-17.1 to -8.0): consensus is manufactured at reduced correctness. Replayed c = 0.5 messages reach 16.2 % (live50 minus replay50 +24.8, 20.5 to 29.3).
decision_3a: Primary (c = 0.25): no resolved excess wrong agreement. Secondary (c = 0.5): an excess well above the 10-point threshold and above replay; at c = 0.5, however, both live agents feed identical inputs from step 1 on, so agreement there is close to construction (any-answer agreement 96 %). The non-trivial finding is that this consensus comes with lower accuracy.
decision_3b: No remedy to test: at c = 0.25 there is no excess to remove (sparse minus live SWA -0.4, -2.9 to +2.0); sparse accuracy differs from live by +2.3 (0.0 to +4.9) at readout 48.
deviations: Arms live50 and replay50 (c = 0.5) were added after the first smoke run and before any development run; they are in the run card.
Development ran phase 1 only (the model rule needs only the independent arm), to save time.
Not run: the text-only communication arm, the single solver at equal total compute, a float64 check and a second model family.

The selfreplay gate (live reproduced exactly) holds for every answer and readout text, but not bitwise: 297 of 1024 rows differ in some pair distance, and 9 in at least one top-1 token, because float32 arithmetic depends on the batch position (phase 2 is a different batch). The run card required exact reproduction; this is a partial gate failure at the trajectory level, not at the answer level.
caveats: Exploratory, one model, one task (two-digit multiplication), one temperature (0.6), 48 soft steps, float32 CPU.

replay50 is not a clean no-reciprocity control. The partner pair it replays is itself locked, so both replay agents receive nearly the same message stream. That common drive alone synchronizes them partly (equal top-1 tokens in 52 % of steps).

The readout time matters: at 24 steps, live c = 0.25 is more accurate than independent (+9.4 points, 6.3 to 12.4), and so is unrelated (+9.5), but replay is not (+0.9). At 24 steps live SWA is lower than independent (-2.5, -4.7 to -0.2). The primary readout is 48.
Same-wrong agreement at c = 0.25 is rare in every arm (about 19-27 of 512 pairs), so the interval of the primary contrast spans about 4.5 points.
